caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular grid-like pattern centered on a faded, light brown background. Inside the rectangular area, numerous thin, horizontal black lines are drawn, spaced somewhat evenly but with slight variations, creating multiple rows. Several of these horizontal rows are differentiated by thicker or darker horizontal lines. A single vertical line runs down the center, dividing the rectangle into two halves. To the left of this vertical axis, another vertical line of blue and red dots is present, aligned from the top to the bottom of the rectangle. Some small handwritten notations appear within the drawing, especially along the vertical column of dots and across a few horizontal lines. At the bottom left margin of the page outside the rectangle, the words “Work Sheet” are written by hand. The overall composition is sketch-like and technical in style, executed primarily in black ink with additional blue and red for the dots.
title: Textile
